svg.title: JVM User App -- Scala/Java --class Entry & __app__.jar
svg.desc: YarnClusterApplication vs JavaMainApplication, __app__.jar staging, AM reflection main(), JavaSparkContext, and exit 15. 1. spark-submit to YARN Client: YarnClusterApplication (edge-01 in-JVM); 2. YARN Client to HDFS NameNode: Stage __app__.jar (nn01:8020); 3. YARN Client to ResourceManager: submitApplication(AM) (rm01:8032); 4. ResourceManager to AM NodeMgr: startContainers(AM) (driver-1:dynamic); 5. AM NodeMgr to ApplicationMaster: Boot AM container (driver-1 OS); 6. ApplicationMaster to JVM User App: Reflect OrdersJob.main() (driver-1 in-JVM); 7. JVM User App to SparkSession: SparkSession.builder() (driver-1 in-JVM); 8. SparkSession to SparkContext: SparkContext / JavaSparkContext (driver-1 in-JVM); 9. JVM User App to ApplicationMaster: main() exit (0 or 15) (driver-1 in-JVM)

g.text: YarnClusterApplication vs JavaMainApplication, __app__.jar staging, AM reflection main(), JavaSparkContext, and exit 15
